notes: The manuscript describes the elementary point-graph cases (70), with the written weights 4 and 1, genera 0 and 1, and written Gamma groups. It then states two types of graphs of the relevant modular dimension: all vertices rational with hat-nu equal to three except a distinguished value four, or one genus-one end vertex while the others are rational. This is an account of manuscript assertions, not a proof of them.

The manuscript asserts a canonical isomorphism of multiplicities in (71), using the distinguished vertex and the set hat-I_alpha0=I_alpha0+tilde-A_alpha0, of cardinal four or one according to the two written genus alternatives. No independent proof of the automorphism-group claims or of (71) was attempted.
